data.name: Bharani
data.gender_notes: Bharani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bharani is a name of the Hindu goddess Durga, who is an embodiment of power and strength. She is often depicted with eight arms, holding various weapons, and riding a lion or tiger. Bharani is worshipped during the Navratri festival and is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and protection. The name Bharani carries the meaning “Goddess Bharani” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bharani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess bharani and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bharani belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Bharani.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bharani total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
